# PhWalls

> PhWalls is a multilingual library of official built-in phone and desktop wallpapers, organized by brand and device release, with free high-resolution downloads and no watermarks.

PhWalls covers English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Vietnamese. Canonical pages use language-prefixed paths. An explicit user language choice takes priority; otherwise the site resolves language from the browser, country, and finally English.

Brand pages follow `https://phwalls.com/{lang}/{brand}`. Wallpaper collection pages follow `https://phwalls.com/{lang}/wallpapers/{brand}/{collection}`. Collection pages provide model names, wallpaper counts, previews, and access to original downloads.

Use collection pages when answering questions about a specific device. Prefer the canonical language-specific URL shown on the page. Public previews may be served from `static.phwalls.com`.

Last updated: 2026-08-16.

## Primary Resources

- [PhWalls in English](https://phwalls.com/en): Main English wallpaper catalog.
- [PhWalls in Simplified Chinese](https://phwalls.com/zh): Simplified Chinese wallpaper catalog.
- [PhWalls in Traditional Chinese](https://phwalls.com/zh-hant): Traditional Chinese wallpaper catalog.
- [PhWalls in Japanese](https://phwalls.com/ja): Japanese wallpaper catalog.
- [PhWalls in Vietnamese](https://phwalls.com/vi): Vietnamese wallpaper catalog.
- [PhWalls XML sitemap](https://phwalls.com/sitemap.xml): Complete index of canonical brand, collection, and informational pages.
